rows.definition: The optional backend predicate reports whether the loaded Vulkan bundle's fused routed-FFN gate/up module serves the given (gate, up) dtype pair, checked before a batched routed layer picks the two-dispatch fused path over the five-dispatch id path.
rows.distinction: It reports one dtype PAIR for the fused gate/up kernel; SupportsV41RoutedFusedDown reports the single down dtype of the companion kernel, and SupportsV41RoutedIDWeight reports the id path's per-projection dtypes. None of them reports model-execution fitness.

rows.definition: The optional backend predicate reports whether the loaded Vulkan bundle's fused routed-FFN down/sum module serves the given down-projection dtype, checked before a batched routed layer picks the two-dispatch fused path over the five-dispatch id path.
rows.distinction: It reports the single down dtype for the fused down/sum kernel; SupportsV41RoutedFusedGateUp reports the gate/up dtype pair of the companion kernel. It is a device-capability predicate, never a quality or correctness claim about fused output.
